purpose: Define strict mathematical contribution budgets for Stage 1 district scoring and Stage 2 cluster selection to prevent single-signal dominance and cluster mode collapse.

stage_1_district_signal_budget.description: Deterministic evidence channels for Stage 1 district probability scoring before stochastic/context softening.

channel_A_terminal_mule_geography.rationale: Reduced from V6.2 unconstrained multiplier (2.4) which pushed terminal mule district match to 63.53% (exceeding <=48% hard gate). Caps terminal mule direct influence at 30%.

channel_B_dominant_downstream_account_ge.rationale: Reduced from V6.2 multiplier (2.6) which drove dominant account match to 64.32% (exceeding <=55% hard gate). Caps dominant account influence at 30%.

channel_C_route_trajectory_and_flow.rationale: Encourages distributed path dynamics (direction strength, majority downstream share, alignment) rather than direct district identity shortcuts.

channel_D_behavioral_and_origin_context.rationale: Origin district proximity, transaction velocity, amount bracket, and complaint severity context.

channel_E_leakage_safe_history.rationale: Strictly chronological cross-district flow frequencies with log1p dampening, capped at 5% to prevent feedback loops.

conflict_handling.action: Increase distribution entropy by injecting a flat Dirichlet/uniform softening prior (+0.25 base smoothing across adjacent districts). Prevent winner-take-all dominance.

stage_2_cluster_signal_budget.description: Probabilistic cluster selection within the realized cashout district to guarantee marginal and conditional cluster diversity.

historical_popularity_controls.rationale: V6.2 allowed 12% global popularity feedback, resulting in Connaught Place reaching 7.27% (>5% gate). V6.3 enforces a strict 6% log-saturated ceiling.

portfolio_rotation_controls.primary_cluster_rotation: Within each district, primary cluster eligibility rotates across role-matched clusters based on deterministic hash of case index and sub-prototype id, ensuring no single cluster is perpetually the primary.
portfolio_rotation_controls.fraud_to_role_only_invariant: Fraud types map strictly to functional role distribution weights, NEVER directly to cluster IDs. Marketplace fraud maps across retail, commercial, and cyber cafe roles distributed across all 11 districts.
